working_title: Source-View Supervision for Feed-Forward Gaussian Reconstruction from Monocular Events
working_title_zh_cn: 面向单目事件前馈高斯重建的源视图监督
scientific_objective: Determine whether training-time source-view grayscale supervision improves held-out novel-view rendering from monocular events with known intrinsics and predicted source poses.
scientific_objective_zh_cn: 检验仅在训练时使用源视图灰度监督，能否改善单目事件在已知内参、预测源位姿条件下的留出新视角渲染。

primary_scientific_questions.research_question: How does source-view supervision affect paired held-out rendering metrics and sensitivity to zero events across DSEC, EventScape and MVSEC?
primary_scientific_questions.research_question_zh_cn: 源视图监督如何影响 DSEC、EventScape 和 MVSEC 的同窗画质指标及对真实事件输入的依赖？
primary_scientific_questions.expected_finding: The sign and magnitude of the change are empirical outcomes and may differ with the data domain and camera displacement.
primary_scientific_questions.expected_finding_zh_cn: 以同窗实验确定收益或退步，分别检验不同数据域和目标位移下的变化。

primary_scientific_questions.research_question: How does event distillation affect depth and pose on held-out clips?
primary_scientific_questions.research_question_zh_cn: 事件蒸馏如何影响留出片段的深度和位姿？
primary_scientific_questions.expected_finding: Geometry effects can vary by metric and training domain.
primary_scientific_questions.expected_finding_zh_cn: 几何变化可能随指标和训练域而异。

primary_scientific_questions.research_question: How much of the rendering error is associated with source camera estimation?
primary_scientific_questions.research_question_zh_cn: 源相机估计对渲染误差有多大影响？
primary_scientific_questions.expected_finding: Matched intrinsics and pose interventions quantify camera sensitivity.
primary_scientific_questions.expected_finding_zh_cn: 用同窗的内参与位姿替换量化相机误差的影响。

methodological_hypothesis: An auxiliary source-view photometric loss can improve appearance preservation without changing the inference inputs or the frozen geometry backbone.
methodological_hypothesis_zh_cn: 源视图光度损失有望减少外观细节损失，同时保持推理输入和冻结几何骨干一致。
data_scope_zh_cn: MVSEC 室内航线共享窗口
claim_boundary: Limit claims to the evaluated splits, target times and camera protocols. Separate privileged camera diagnostics from event-only inference and report failures and zero-event controls.
claim_boundary_zh_cn: 结论限于已测划分、目标时刻和相机协议。分别报告外部参考相机诊断和只输入事件的推理，并记录失败及全零事件对照。
